chain.label: Boeing/FedEx maintenance manuals and parts catalog depict bannis latch inconsistently
chain.trigger: review of the Boeing 757 and FedEx aircraft maintenance manuals (AMMs) and the Boeing illustrated parts catalog (IPC) found that all contained inconsistent depictions of the bannis latch configuration as required by ADs 86-09-09 and 2001-15-01

chain.label: R1 bannis latch nonconforming: one link, missing spacers and required hardware per AD 86-09-09
chain.trigger: the R1 bannis latch on the accident airplane had only one link and lacked other required hardware

caused_by.evidence: These inconsistent, conflicting depictions would likely be confusing to maintenance personnel and could lead to the installation of and failure to detect nonconforming latches

chain.label: Improper maintenance: L1 deployment strap misrouted; latch inspection checked cable rather than the required chain
chain.trigger: the deployment strap was incorrectly routed, which prevented the door from opening ... The work card indicated to check the cables for fraying. At that time, there should have been a chain in the latch assembly and not a cable

caused_by.evidence: None of these resources depict the bannis latch with all required modifications ... could lead to the installation of and failure to detect nonconforming latches

chain.label: Left hydraulic system failure shortly after takeoff from CHA
chain.trigger: received an engine indication and crew alerting system message indicating a failure of the left hydraulic system shortly after takeoff

chain.label: Landing gear could not be extended despite multiple attempts
chain.trigger: The flight crew turned the airplane back to CHA but was unable to lower the landing gear. After multiple attempts to extend the gear were unsuccessful

caused_by.evidence: failure of the left hydraulic system ... was unable to lower the landing gear

chain.label: Crew declared an emergency and made a gear-up landing at CHA
chain.trigger: the crew declared an emergency and performed an emergency gear up landing

caused_by.evidence: After multiple attempts to extend the gear were unsuccessful, the crew declared an emergency and performed an emergency gear up landing

chain.label: Airplane could not be stopped and slid off the departure end of runway 20
chain.trigger: the flight crew was unable to stop the airplane, and it slid off the departure end of runway 20

caused_by.evidence: During the emergency landing, the flight crew was unable to stop the airplane, and it slid off the departure end of runway 20

chain.label: Impacted localizer antennas, coming to rest about 830 ft beyond the runway with substantial damage
chain.trigger: impacted localizer antennas, and came to rest about 830 ft beyond the end of the runway

caused_by.evidence: slid off the departure end of runway 20, impacted localizer antennas, and came to rest about 830 ft beyond the end of the runway

chain.label: Both forward exits obstructed during evacuation: L1 door would not open fully and its slide did not deploy; R1 door lodged on the slide pack
chain.trigger: The door rotated halfway open but would not open fully, and the slide did not deploy ... attempted to open the right (R1) door, but it lodged on the slide pack

caused_by.evidence: had only one link and lacked other required hardware, which caused the slide pack to jam before the jumpseat occupant was eventually able to force the door to open
although its bannis latch conformed to required modifications, the deployment strap was incorrectly routed, which prevented the door from opening

chain.label: Jumpseat occupant forced the R1 door open; slide deployed and all three occupants evacuated uninjured
chain.trigger: The jumpseat occupant used force to open the R1 door, and the slide deployed normally ... Both flight crewmembers and the jumpseat occupant were uninjured.

caused_by.evidence: The jumpseat occupant used force to open the R1 door, and the slide deployed normally
